firm_data.firm_description: Adelman Matz P.C. is a midsize firm headquartered in New York City with offices in Los Angeles, Austin and Atlanta. They offer experience in all areas of Corporate Law, Business Services, Intellectual Property, Branding, Litigation, Employment, Technology, Hospitality and Entertainment Law.
notable_facts: The firm was formed in 2013 by Gary Adelman and Sarah Matz.
They have sister firms in over 20 states and 100 countries.
The firm represents clients in music, film, apparel, health & beauty, technology and products industries.

email.subject: AI for Adelman Matz, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Gary,

Since you founded Adelman Matz in 2013, you've built a 25-attorney firm that competes across Corporate Law, IP, and Litigation while managing multiple offices from NYC to Atlanta. That's exactly the operating model that benefits most from what we do.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the LA office region to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
